# ASU Elsevier Pure

> A comprehensive research expertise and publication tracking platform for Arizona State University, enabling discovery of faculty expertise and research collaboration opportunities.

ASU Elsevier Pure is Arizona State University's institutional research information system, powered by Elsevier's Pure platform. It aggregates researcher profiles, publication records, and collaboration networks to support research visibility and institutional analytics across ASU's academic community.
